unit.why: A teaching on the value of learning a few laws daily (citing Rashbash), illustrated by the author's (Hida's) childhood memory of R. Hayyim ben Attar's Motzaei Shabbat study vigil. That memory describes a habitual practice rather than a narrated event, so it is not a story.
